repro.expectedBehavior: A balanced parenthesized group keeps state.parens at 0 and emits an unescaped closing paren; an unmatched ')' is escaped as a literal without driving state.parens below zero, so a later balanced group is still tracked correctly.

Test prefixes an unmatched ')' before the same balanced group: the unmatched paren should be escaped without decrementing below zero, so the later '(a)' should still close with ')' and end at parens 0. On the buggy code the first ')' decrements to -1, the later '(' only returns to 0, and its ')' is escaped, ending at -1.

finding.claim: Last-token update uses truthiness of prevIndex, so when the only slash is at index 0 the condition is false and token value/depth/maxDepth are never updated.
finding.title: Falsy zero index skips last token update

verifier.reason: The code at scan.js:390 gates the final token assignment on truthy prevIndex, while scan.js:382 sets prevIndex to the slash index i, so a sole slash at index 0 leaves prevIndex falsy and skips scan.js:391-393; the trailing token pushed at scan.js:357-359 is not processed by the slash loop at scan.js:366, and scan.js:386 shows the correct prevIndex !== undefined check was available.
